description: Source code for a Radio Unit (RU) emulator handling OFH (Open Fronthaul) messages, including configuration, packet processing, and statistics reporting.

classes.name: ru_emulator
classes.description: Class implementing the RU emulator handling OFH message reception, processing, and response generation.

classes.name: worker_manager
classes.description: Class managing thread workers and executors for RU emulators and message reception.

methods.name: resolve_ru_emulator_dependencies
methods.description: Creates and returns dependencies required by the RU emulator, including loggers and sequence ID checkers.

methods.name: fill_random_data
methods.description: Fills a buffer with random bytes based on a seed.

methods.name: set_static_header_params
methods.description: Populates static OFH header fields in a frame based on configuration parameters.

methods.name: generate_test_data
methods.description: Generates pre-filled test data buffers for each symbol and eAxC based on configuration.

methods.name: generate_test_prach
methods.description: Generates pre-filled PRACH U-Plane test data buffers.

methods.name: rx_timing_window_params_us_to_symbols
methods.description: Converts timing parameters from microseconds to OFDM symbol counts.

methods.name: should_packet_be_dropped
methods.description: Determines if a received packet should be dropped based on Ethernet type and size.

methods.name: decode_rx_message
methods.description: Decodes and validates received OFH message content, extracting message info.
